faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPKV Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the MPKV Data Entry Operator posts is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Data Entry Operator post at Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Any Graduate with proficiency in Computer Applications, a valid MSCIT certificate, and specific typing speeds in Marathi and English.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required experience for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: A minimum of four (4) years of experience in a University / State / Central Govt. Project / Contract / Scheme is required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Entry Operator posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth is located in Rahuri, Maharashtra, with the pincode 413722.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any preference given to certain candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates with experience in Sports and NSS related works in the University.
